    43	the goal's giant `leftAdjointUniq` term first-order, so no giant-term defeq is required. -/
    44	private lemma combine_naturality_squares {C : Type*} [Category C]
    45	    {A B₁ B₂ E F G : C}
    46	    (p : A ⟶ B₁) (i₁ : B₁ ⟶ E) (s₁ : E ⟶ F) (i₂ : A ⟶ B₂) (q : B₂ ⟶ E)
    47	    (s₂ : B₂ ⟶ G) (d : G ⟶ F)
    48	    (h1 : p ≫ i₁ = i₂ ≫ q) (h2 : q ≫ s₁ = s₂ ≫ d) :
    49	    p ≫ i₁ ≫ s₁ = (i₂ ≫ s₂) ≫ d := by
    50	  rw [← Category.assoc, h1, Category.assoc, h2, ← Category.assoc]

    54	`leftAdjointUniq` term is captured first-order by `(?e.app _).inv` (no giant-term defeq). -/
    55	private lemma natIso_inv_app_naturality {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    56	    {F G : C ⥤ D} (e : F ≅ G) {A B : C} (g : A ⟶ B) :
    57	    G.map g ≫ (e.app B).inv = (e.app A).inv ≫ F.map g :=

    62	   object dual M.val, hence in M via dualPrecompHom by contravariance); (2) the isoMk(sliceDualTransport)
    63	   square, sectionwise via slice_dual_transport_app_apply (reindex + codomain-unit ring-swap, both
    64	   commute with dualPrecompHom). [prover-mode: mathlib-build] — may need H1-square + slice-square as

    69	    let α : Y.presheaf ⟶ f.opensFunctor.op ⋙ X.presheaf :=

    73	    (PresheafOfModules.pullback φR).map (PresheafOfModules.dualPrecompHom φ.val)
    74	        ≫ (presheafDualPullbackComparison f M).hom
    75	      = (presheafDualPullbackComparison f M').hom
    76	        ≫ PresheafOfModules.dualPrecompHom ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward β).map φ.val) := by

    78	  simp only [presheafDualPullbackComparison, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
    79	  -- Square 2: naturality of the `isoMk (sliceDualTransport)` factor.

    81	        ≫ (PresheafOfModules.isoMk (fun V => sliceDualTransport f M V)
    82	            (by intro V W g; subsingleton)).hom
    83	      = (PresheafOfModules.isoMk (fun V => sliceDualTransport f M' V)
    84	            (by intro V W g; subsingleton)).hom
    85	        ≫ PresheafOfModules.dualPrecompHom ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward β).map φ.val) := by

    88	    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    89	    apply LinearMap.ext

    92	    intro W
    93	    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    94	    apply LinearMap.ext
